skills.name: context-radar
skills.description: Monitor Antigravity session, subagent, and aside context budgets, diagnose cache misses, save key-point notes without breaking active caches, and run gated /compact or new-chat handoffs using context-radar-mcp tools.

readmeMarkdown:
# Context Radar (`context-radar-mcp`) **Know how full your context is before it bites.** Context Radar shows token use, cache hits, and cost for every Antigravity session and subagent, live in the sidebar. When a chat is getting full, it tells you whether to `/compact` or start fresh — and writes the handoff note for you. [Homepage](https://contextradar.eatingdream.dev) · **English** | [简体中文](README.zh-CN.md) · [Releases](https://github.com/eatingDream-antigravity-plugins/context-radar/releases) · [AI Guide](docs/ai-guide.md) · [`llms.txt`](llms.txt) [![CI](https://github.com/eatingDream-antigravity-plugins/context-radar/actions/workflows/ci.yml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/eatingDream-antigravity-plugins/context-radar/actions/workflows/ci.yml) [![Release](assets/release-badge.svg)](https://github.com/eatingDream-antigravity-plugins/context-radar/releases) ![Built with Rust](https://img.shields.io/badge/built%20with-Rust-12151E?logo=rust&logoColor=white) [![License: MIT](https://img.shields.io/badge/license-MIT-12151E)](LICENSE)
## Is It For You? - **Yes, if** you run long multi-turn or multi-subagent sessions in Antigravity and want to spot sudden latency spikes, cache misses, and token bloat before hitting the context wall. - **No, if** you mostly ask short one-off questions that finish well under half the context window—Antigravity's defaults already cover that without an extra side panel. ## What You Get | | | | :--- | :--- | | **Live headroom & subagent view** | Track remaining context tokens, running/waiting/error states, thinking-to-reply ratio, streaming speed, and estimated cost across main sessions and docked subagents. | | **Clear answers when turns slow down** | Pinpoint whether a slow turn came from normal growth, a mid-loop cache drop (TTL expiry, replica spillover, or model switch), or a post-compact rebuild—and catch cross-model `/compact` cache resets. | | **Trim bloat without breaking cache** | Spot which exact turns spiked your context and save a concise digest to `scratch/` out-of-band so your active prompt cache stays hot. | | **Compaction only when it pays off** | Check budget thresholds, active subagents, and break-even turns before running `/compact` or handing off to a fresh chat, with automatic CLI support for unattended runs. | | **100% local & read-only** | Runs as a single native Rust binary with zero outbound network calls, zero telemetry, and read-only access to Antigravity's local session logs. | ## Quick Start ```sh curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/eatingDream-antigravity-plugins/context-radar/main/scripts/install.sh | sh ``` Verifies the release archive SHA-256 automatically · Refreshes MCP servers automatically inside Antigravity (use `--reload` outside or `--no-reload` to skip) · Supports macOS (Apple Silicon & Intel) and Linux `x86_64` · Pin a tag with `CONTEXT_RADAR_VERSION=vX.Y.Z` · Remove cleanly anytime with `... | sh -s -- --uninstall`. Reload Antigravity, open **Context Radar** in the side pane, or ask your agent: - *"Why did the last few turns get slow?"* - *"Which turns bloated this session, and is it worth running `/compact` now?"* ### 30-Second Local Demo Check your live local telemetry latency or inspect the built panel offline right from the terminal: ```sh ~/.gemini/config/plugins/context-radar-mcp/bin/context-radar-mcp bench --iterations 5 ``` Or from a source checkout: ```sh npm --prefix panel ci --ignore-scripts && npm --prefix panel run build && open panel/dist/panel.html ``` ## For AI Agents Context Radar ships machine-readable docs and a portable skill (`agentskills.io` compatible) for Antigravity, Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, and OpenCode: ```sh npx skills add eatingDream-antigravity-plugins/context-radar ``` > **Agent hint**: Read [`llms.txt`](llms.txt), [`skills/context-radar/SKILL.md`](skills/context-radar/SKILL.md), and [`docs/ai-guide.md`](docs/ai-guide.md) for MCP tool schemas, headless ACP workflows, settings, and source builds. ## Safety & Privacy - **Zero network & zero telemetry**: Reads local Antigravity ledgers in read-only mode and never transmits prompts, paths, or metrics off your machine. - **Symlink-safe local writes**: Out-of-band `scratch/` digests and single-use handoff grants are scoped to the active conversation and workspace with owner-only (`0600`) atomic writes. - **Self-contained panel UI**: Single offline HTML bundle with strict `default-src 'none'` CSP, zero external requests, and zero `innerHTML` writes. ## Documentation - [AI Agent & Operator Guide](docs/ai-guide.md) — Full MCP tool schemas, ACP `acp-proxy` / `acp-run`, settings & env vars, source build - [Portable Agent Skill (`SKILL.md`)](skills/context-radar/SKILL.md) · [LLM Index (`llms.txt`)](llms.txt) - [Settings Example](settings.example.json) · [Contributor Guide](AGENTS.md) · [Changelog](CHANGELOG.md) · [Security](SECURITY.md) · [Contributing](CONTRIBUTING.md) ## Antigravity Plugin Suite Part of the [Antigravity Plugins](https://github.com/eatingDream-antigravity-plugins) suite: **Context Radar** · [Clam Guard](https://github.com/eatingDream-antigravity-plugins/clam-guard) · [Remote Cast](https://github.com/eatingDream-antigravity-plugins/remote-cast) · [Colab Deck](https://github.com/eatingDream-antigravity-plugins/colab-deck) · [Panel Kit](https://github.com/eatingDream-antigravity-plugins/panel-kit). ## License Licensed under the [MIT License](LICENSE).
